title: Leaked memo: a top Senate administrator gave aides the green light to use ChatGPT, Gemini, and Copilot for official Senate work, including preparing briefings (Catie Edmondson/New York Times)
summary: Catie Edmondson / New York Times: Leaked memo: a top Senate administrator gave aides the green light to use ChatGPT, Gemini, and Copilot for official Senate work, including preparing briefings — New guidelines said Senate aides could use A.I. tools for official work, including research, drafting and editing documents …
